description:
This is my fifth time joining this hackathon because I love it so much, and this is second time going solo, but I would really appreciate if someone can join me. I am looking for someone who wants to go through 48 hours of torture with me.

Jokes aside, I am looking for someone who has programming and graphic design skills. I know Python (I am learning it currently), C#, Java, CSS, HTML, JavaScript, Kotlin, and C, so if y'all know any of these, that's a plus!
